A '''Yarkora colony''' on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] [[Carlac]] was [[Colonist|settled]] by members of the [[Yarkora]] [[species]]<ref name="Visual Guide" /> by [[132 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> The colony was located in Carlac's [[Temperature|cold]] [[blue-sand]] equatorial [[desert]]s. It was situated south of monasteries raised by [[Ming Po]] [[monk]]s and was far from the subpolar [[Piteous Ranges]] [[mountain]] chain.<ref name="Visual Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Yarkora colony was mentioned in [[Pablo Hidalgo]]'s [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''.<ref name="Visual Guide" />
